item.title: Federal agents search Rep. Ilhan Omar's DC home
item.description: The Justice Department says the search is part of an ongoing federal investigation, while Omar calls it an attempt to target political enemies.

item.title: DOJ opens antitrust probe of TV networks
item.description: The Justice Department is investigating several TV networks for possible antitrust violations. President Trump also pressures Ukrainians to elect a new leader.

item.title: US drone restrictions strain police budgets
item.description: The US government seeks to end China's dominance in low-cost, high-quality drones, but added restrictions are driving up costs for cash-strapped police departments.
